obligations.text: A warehouse scanner reports that a pallet was moved from bay A to bay B.
A later record states that the same pallet is now assigned to a different storage zone.
A supervisor may authorize a worker to release a shipment, while the worker may lack authority to change the release policy.
A sensor reading is collected, but another record is required before the reading is treated as reliable evidence.
A safety rule prevents a machine from entering a specified operating condition.
A tool is available to perform an operation even when no operation is currently being performed.
A request can be accepted, executed, and later produce a changed condition in an external system.
Two observers can report different accounts of the same situation before additional records reconcile the accounts.
A previously issued permission can be withdrawn before a pending operation completes.
A completed external operation may remain effective even after a local acknowledgement is lost.
A plan may intentionally keep several alternatives open because available information does not justify choosing one.
Changing the software used to perform an operation does not by itself imply that the resulting external condition is a different condition.
